bio.text: Jonathan Makeley is the Prohibition Party's nominee for governor of New York in 2026; Ballot Access News reported in May 2026 that he will not seek a place on the ballot and will ask for write-in votes.

According to his campaign website, he is a historian who focuses on American reform movements, with a bachelor's degree in history from Alfred University and master's degrees from the University at Buffalo.
His campaign website says he grew up in Angelica, New York, and lives in Amherst, New York.
